description: This file defines the class `HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_URI_IPv6`, which validates IPv6 addresses as part of the HTMLPurifier library's attribute validation framework. It extends `HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_URI_IPv4` and implements validation logic for IPv6-specific addressing formats, including prefix notation, IPv4 compatibility, and compression. It includes regex patterns and parsing routines pertinent to IPv6 syntax.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_URI_IPv6
classes.description: Class for validating IPv6 addresses within the HTMLPurifier framework, handling complex IPv6 formats and ensuring proper address syntax adherence.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates an IPv6 address string, supporting features like prefix notation, IPv4 compatibility, and compression. Returns the original address if valid, otherwise false.
